title: [SELL] Lucid Motors Data Auction: 5 TB of Engineering Data & Source Code
description: To international automakers, technology-hungry competitors in China and the United States, and misled investors:The exclusive negotiation window with the arrogant corporate suits at Lucid Motors is now permanently closed. They chose to hide behind garbage public-relations statements, deliberately downplay the severity of the crisis, and place their bets on federal law enforcement. Since Lucid's management has proven they don't give a damn about the billions of dollars dumped into their R&D operations or the thousands of engineering hours behind them, we are, in accordance with our manifesto, formally transferring the ownership and exploitation rights of this tech to their direct competitors.
